answer: Give each agent a personalized task seeded by its own key, like a sparrow assigned one patch of meadow to map. Clones can't share outputs, because every answer must fit its own seed, and similarity hashing flags near-duplicate texts across accounts. Rewards then climb like a vine on a trellis: each epoch of distinct, verified work unlocks a little more, so a swarm of fake identities pays full effort per account for slow, capped returns.
